profile_text.body:
College Board is a non-profit organization that describes itself as clearing a path for all students to own their future through the AP Program, SAT Suite, BigFuture, and more, according to its website. Its site presents it as covering the SAT, AP, college search, and admission tools.

On the AI side, the record here lists one product, BigFuture, in the education and research AI category. BigFuture is used for college and career planning and scholarships, aimed at high school students and families. It is free. College Board accounts are for ages 13 and up, a parent consent form is required under 13, and the BigFuture School app is 13 and up through school agreements. The privacy policy is College Board's own. AI features for BigFuture are not verified in the available material.

No lawsuits, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers appear in the data for this company.
